items.question: What is UGC and how can it help my brand?
items.answer: UGC (User Generated Content) consists of authentic consumer-style videos created by creators for advertising campaigns. Unlike corporate ads, UGC generates up to 4x more engagement and builds greater trust. With 28+ active campaigns and 158 Fiverr reviews (4.8/5), I create UGC ads, testimonials, demos, and lifestyle content for TikTok, Reels, and Meta Ads.

items.question: What types of UGC content do you create?
items.answer: I create UGC ads for TikTok and Meta with strong hooks, spokesperson videos, testimonials and reviews, product demos and how-tos, lifestyle content and B-Roll, and on-camera videos with voiceover. Everything in Spanish, English, or both languages, in vertical format (9:16) optimized for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and Meta Ads.

items.question: Do you publish the content on your social media?
items.answer: No. The content I create is exclusively for the contracting brand's use. You receive all files and the rights to publish on your channels, paid ads, or wherever needed. It does not appear on my personal social media unless a specific brand ambassador agreement with agreed terms is established.

items.question: How does the work process work?
items.answer: The process has 7 steps: 1) You request the service and share your brand details, 2) I send a proposal and quote, 3) You approve and make payment, 4) You send the product if applicable, 5) We confirm the brief and script (if in English), 6) I record and edit the content, 7) I deliver the videos ready to publish. Everything is managed remotely and professionally.

items.question: How much does UGC content cost?
items.answer: Pricing varies based on content type, number of videos, language, and project complexity. For a personalized quote, contact me through the form or via Fiverr. Each project is quoted based on your specific needs with no hidden fees.

items.question: Do you include revisions?
items.answer: Yes, each project includes 1 to 2 revision rounds. These cover editing adjustments, pacing, on-screen text, or minor focus changes. Major changes such as full re-recordings or structural modifications may have an additional cost depending on the scope of the work.

items.question: How long does content delivery take?
items.answer: Standard delivery time is 3 to 5 business days from product receipt and brief confirmation. For larger packages or multi-video projects, timelines may vary. If you have an urgent deadline, mention it at the start of the project so we can coordinate accordingly.

items.question: What usage rights does the brand get over the content?
items.answer: Usage rights for organic posts are included in all projects. If you need to use the content in paid ads (Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Google Ads, etc.), this requires a paid usage license quoted separately. Specific rights are clearly defined in the contract for each project.

items.question: Do you work with international brands?
items.answer: Yes, I work with brands from 30+ countries. My priority markets are Hispanic audiences in the USA, followed by Europe (including Spain), Canada, Australia, New Zealand, and Asia. With 28+ active campaigns and 158 Fiverr reviews (4.8/5 stars), I offer remote production to international standards from Medellín.

items.question: What languages do you work in?
items.answer: I work primarily in Spanish, my native language, with no word count restrictions and no script required. I also create content in English with a limit of up to 65 words per video and with a script provided by the brand to ensure accuracy and naturalness. Ideal for bilingual brands or those targeting US and English-speaking markets.
